$comment: Routes through this process, as data. Each path lists the answers given at each human task (by BPMN id; a list is used once per loop round), the tasks left alone (a timer takes over), what it must reach and the data it must end with. Used by e2e/seed/tools/validate_catalog.py (engine only) and by run-seeded-processes.spec.ts (the running app). expect_end / expect_completed / expect_not_reached / expect_data.at use top-level element ids (the app lists top-level elements only). "@now+5s" becomes a date-time.
